title: Energy and Matter Sort
intro: Sort where plant mass comes from, where food energy started, and which way a food-web arrow points.
note: This is a sorting game model. The real bean light-and-dark fair test and the string food web in the lesson still count.
summary: Matter (water, air, soil, dead leaves) has mass and takes up space; energy (sunlight, heat, motion) does not. Plants build their mass mostly from air and water, and food energy started as sunlight. Producers make food, consumers eat, decomposers break down dead matter. Matter is reused, and 100 g of dead leaves became 35 g of pieces, 55 g of richer soil and about 10 g of gas. Energy ends up as heat and motion.

stages.prompt: Matter has mass and takes up space. Energy is the ability to cause change. Which is it?

cards.label: Water the plant takes in
cards.why: Water has mass and takes up space. Plants build most of their mass from water and air.
cards.hint: does it have mass and take up space?

cards.label: Air the plant takes in
cards.why: Air is matter. Plants get most of their growth material from air and water.
cards.hint: does it have mass and take up space, even if you cannot see it?

cards.label: Dead leaves
cards.why: Dead leaves are matter. Decomposers break them down and the matter goes back to soil and air.
cards.hint: does it have mass and take up space?

cards.label: Soil in the pot
cards.why: Soil is matter. In the tree argument it barely changed, from 100 kg to 99.9 kg.
cards.hint: does it have mass and take up space?

cards.label: Sunlight on a leaf
cards.why: Sunlight is energy, not matter. The plant uses it to make food.
cards.hint: can you weigh it, or does it make things happen?

cards.label: Heat from a deer's body
cards.why: Heat is energy. Food energy ends up as heat and motion.
cards.hint: can you weigh it, or is it what lets things change?

cards.label: The deer's running motion
cards.why: Motion uses energy from food. The deer's body is matter, but the motion is energy.
cards.hint: is this the stuff, or the moving?

stages.prompt: How does each living thing get its food?

cards.label: Maple tree
cards.why: A maple tree uses light to make its own food, so it is a producer.
cards.hint: does it eat anything, or use light to make food?

cards.label: Algae in Lake Michigan
cards.why: Algae make food from light, like plants.
cards.hint: does it eat anything, or use light to make food?

cards.label: Rabbit
cards.why: A rabbit eats plants, so it is a consumer.
cards.hint: how does it get its food?

cards.label: Fox
cards.why: A fox eats other animals, so it is a consumer.
cards.hint: how does it get its food?

cards.label: Small fish in a lake
cards.why: Small fish eat other living things, so they are consumers.
cards.hint: how does it get its food?

cards.label: Mushroom on a dead log
cards.why: A mushroom breaks down dead matter and returns it to the soil.
cards.hint: does it use light, eat other animals, or feed on something dead?

cards.label: Microbes in the soil
cards.why: Microbes break down dead matter. That returns matter to soil and air.
cards.hint: does it use light, eat other animals, or feed on something dead?

stages.prompt: Where did the energy in this food first come from?

cards.label: Michigan apple
cards.why: An apple tree captured sunlight. The apple has food energy.
cards.hint: what did the tree capture to make it?

cards.label: Ear of corn
cards.why: The corn plant captured sunlight to make food.
cards.hint: what did the plant capture to make it?

cards.label: Chicken that ate corn
cards.why: The chicken ate corn, and the corn got its energy from the Sun.
cards.hint: what did its food get from the Sun?

cards.label: Sandwich
cards.why: Food is stored Sun energy, captured first by plants.
cards.hint: where did the plants in it get their energy?

cards.label: Refrigerator
cards.why: A refrigerator only keeps food cold. It does not make food energy.
cards.hint: did it make the food energy?

cards.label: Store package
cards.why: A package only holds food. Food energy started as sunlight.
cards.hint: did it make the food energy?

stages.prompt: Dead leaves broke down. Is this matter that gets reused, or energy that ends up as heat and motion?

bins.label: Energy that ends as heat and motion

cards.label: 35 g of leaf pieces
cards.why: Of 100 g of dead leaves, 35 g stayed as pieces. The matter did not disappear.
cards.hint: is this stuff you could weigh?

cards.label: 55 g became richer soil
cards.why: 55 g of the leaves became richer soil. Matter returns to the soil.
cards.hint: is this stuff you could weigh?

cards.label: About 10 g went into the air as gas
cards.why: About 10 g went into the air as gas. Matter returns to soil and air.
cards.hint: is this stuff you could weigh?

cards.label: Heat from a fox's body
cards.why: Food energy ends up as heat and motion.
cards.hint: is this stuff, or the ability to cause change?

cards.label: The fox's running motion
cards.why: Motion is where food energy ends up. It is not reused like matter.
cards.hint: is this stuff, or the ability to cause change?
